# algizian_client (Resource)

An OAuth/OIDC client of a tenant. The authorization code flow with PKCE `S256` is required for every client. The `client_secret` of a confidential client is returned once at creation and kept in the Terraform state (sensitive): protect the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algizian_client" "web" {
  tenant        = algizian_tenant.myapp.slug
  name          = "MyApp web"
  type          = "confidential"
  redirect_uris = ["https://app.example.com/auth/callback"]
  tags          = { app = "web" }
}

resource "algizian_client" "mobile" {
  tenant        = algizian_tenant.myapp.slug
  name          = "MyApp mobile"
  redirect_uris = ["com.example.myapp:/oauth2redirect"]
}

output "web_client_id" {
  value = algizian_client.web.id
}

output "web_client_secret" {
  value     = algizian_client.web.client_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1 to 80 characters.
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Allowed redirect URIs (1 to 20): https, or `http://localhost` / loopback for development, or a custom scheme for native apps.
- `tenant` (String) Slug of the tenant.

### Optional

- `first_party` (Boolean) A first-party client skips the consent screen.
- `grant_types` (Set of String) `authorization_code` and/or `refresh_token`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Free labels (at most 20; keys start with a letter and use `a-z 0-9 . _ : -`, values up to 256 characters). Algizian never reads them. The map replaces the object's tags as a whole; set `{}` to clear them.
- `type` (String) `public` (browser and mobile apps, no secret) or `confidential` (server-side, has a secret). Cannot be changed.

### Read-Only

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Shown once by the API for `confidential` clients; null for public clients, and null after an import.
- `id` (String) The client id (`c_...`), also the `client_id` of the OIDC flow.
- `registration` (String) How the client was registered: `api` for this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <tenant slug>/<client id>; the secret of a confidential client cannot be imported
terraform import algizian_client.web k3x9q2a/c_abc123
```
